Third-party code shipped with RegiBase (read and written in the browser; nothing here is loaded from elsewhere).

kdbxweb 2.1.1 — kdbxweb.min.js
  KeePass (.kdbx) file format in JavaScript. https://github.com/keeweb/kdbxweb
  Copyright (C) 2021 Antelle. MIT License.

hash-wasm 4.13.0 — argon2.umd.min.js
  The Argon2 part of hash-wasm (Argon2d, Argon2i, Argon2id as WebAssembly). https://github.com/Daninet/hash-wasm
  Copyright (c) 2020 Dani Biró. MIT License.
